meta.title: Dead Even
meta.why: Six stats with the winner swapping sides almost every row, so the viewer keeps a running count, and the buzzer lands on 3-3: the GOAT debate in seven seconds, without picking a side.
meta.facts: Final ATP singles career records; both players are retired (Federer 2022, Nadal 2024), so the numbers are frozen. Sources: ATP Tour (player bios and retirement features, Lexus ATP Head2Head) and Wikipedia (Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, Federer-Nadal rivalry). Grand Slam titles 20 vs 22; weeks at No. 1 310 vs 209; tour-level titles 103 vs 92; ATP Masters 1000 titles 28 vs 36; ATP Finals titles 6 vs 0; head-to-head Nadal leads 24-16 in 40 meetings. Colours: Wimbledon grass for Federer, Roland Garros clay for Nadal.
